This is a mineral or chemical fertilizer containing three nutrients (N, P, K), so it falls under heading 3105. Sub-heading 3105.20 covers mineral or chemical fertilizers containing the three fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. The HTSUS code for that is 3105.20.00 with a statistical suffix, typically 3105.20.0000.

Packaging in containers over 10 kg does not matter here, because the one-liter containers are still under the 10 kg limit. Heading 3105 covers goods put up in tablets or similar forms, or in packages of a gross weight not exceeding 10 kg. The sub-heading 3105.20 is not split by package size, so the one-liter containers do not change the classification.

The product is a liquid with a density of 1.41 g/mL, so one liter weighs about 1.41 kg, which is under 10 kg. It is still classified in 3105.20.
